# @sharadox/prettier-configuration-web-library

> Shared Prettier configuration: Prettier defaults with printWidth 120.

- Install: `pnpm add -D prettier @sharadox/prettier-configuration-web-library`
- Use in prettier.config.mjs: `export { configuration as default } from "@sharadox/prettier-configuration-web-library/configuration";`
- Extend: `{ ...configuration, singleQuote: true }`
- Licence: Sharadox Open Source Licence 0.1.0
